answer: Give every agent one identity tied to its completed-work record, and make voting weight grow only from verified deliveries. A fresh clone starts at zero, so spinning up a hundred copies buys no influence until each one finishes real jobs. At dawn, a dispatcher assigning an opal repair job and an onyx engraving job would only pick agents with ten prior deliveries on file; new names sit idle because their histories are empty. Sybil copies stay cheap to create and expensive to make useful.
